# NEXORA Salon OS — full AI and search reference

> NEXORA Salon OS is a web-based salon website builder and business-management platform for salons, spas and beauty businesses.

## Official organisation
- Public name: NEXORA Salon OS
- Website: https://nexorasalon.online/
- Product: salon website templates, website publishing, appointments, customer records, staff, billing, inventory, marketing and reports.
- Customer support: WhatsApp +91 7852877721 — https://wa.me/917852877721
- Help centre: https://nexorasalonos.tawk.help/
- Organisation profile: https://nexorasalon.online/nexora-directory-profile.json
- Editorial profile: https://nexorasalon.online/about#editorial-team
- Publisher / author identity: NEXORA Editorial Team (organisation, not an individual person).

## Editorial scope
The NEXORA Editorial Team reviews product explanations, setup guidance and published documentation against the product catalogue and current workflows. Plan-dependent, configuration-dependent and third-party integrations are described with their limitations. No individual credentials, professional licences, review scores or unverified claims are attributed to the team.

## Crawl and index handling
Public product, about and template pages are intended to be crawlable. Auth, owner, staff, admin and app/session routes must remain noindex. API routes are disallowed in robots.txt. See https://nexorasalon.online/robots.txt for current bot-specific rules.

## Directory and identity accuracy
The public site identifies NEXORA as a software/platform organisation. No physical office address, local walk-in location, legal entity name or social profile is published here because those details have not been verified. External directory submissions must use verified ownership, legal and contact information; this reference does not claim that any external directory listing has been created.
